question: How have advancements in synthetic biology and genetic engineering techniques contributed to the development of more efficient recombinant protein expression systems?

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: Answer identifies CRISPR-Cas technology (knockout screens and CRISPRi) as a transformative genetic engineering advancement enabling precise, targeted genome modifications that improve recombinant protein expression systems.
examples: CRISPR-Cas9 enables precise gene knockouts that enhance protein yield in host organisms
CRISPRi provides a new application in genomic engineering to control recombinant gene expression

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: Answer describes the first pooled CRISPR-Cas9 knockout screen in Komagataella phaffii, which predicts essentiality of secreted-protein genes and identifies vacuolar and cell wall-related genes whose disruption improves recombinant protein secretion.
examples: Knocking out vacuolar and cell wall-related genes enhances secretion of recombinant proteins
Disrupting cell wall structure may facilitate diffusion of large proteins into the extracellular space

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: Answer explains leaky gene expression as a problem for recombinant protein yield and describes a modular CRISPRi system using sgRNAs targeting the PT7/LacO1 promoter to reduce basal leaky expression and increase the dynamic range of T7RNAP-driven recombinant expression.
examples: sgRNA-guided CRISPRi represses basal transcription from T7 promoters
Reducing leaky expression improves protein yield and stability of engineered circuits

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: Answer describes Ribo-T, a ribosome with covalently tethered 16S/23S rRNA subunits forming a single chimeric molecule, and its evolutionary optimization to overcome the low activity of the original design, supporting faster cell growth and increased protein expression.
examples: Evolutionary selection improved Ribo-T designs supporting faster cell growth and higher protein yields
Optimized Ribo-T synthesizes a diverse set of proteins

ingredients.name: answer_critical_4
ingredients.criterion: Answer explains how orthogonal Ribo-T/mRNA pairs function in parallel with but independently of native translation machinery, dedicating translation to recombinant proteins and increasing the efficiency and control of expression without burdening the host.
examples: Orthogonal ribosome-mRNA pairs enable dedicated translation of recombinant proteins
Orthogonality increases efficiency of recombinant protein synthesis without burdening native machinery

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: Answer notes that these approaches are modular or generalizable, e.g., adapting the CRISPRi system to other promoters by changing sgRNAs, or applying engineered ribosomes to diverse proteins and hosts.
examples: CRISPRi is potentially generalizable to other gene expression systems by changing sgRNAs
Modular design supports portability across hosts and promoters

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: Answer notes that tighter expression control benefits host fitness, e.g., CRISPRi-enhanced growth of bacteria suffering from leaky expression of toxic proteins.
examples: CRISPRi improved growth of bacteria with leaky expression of a toxic protein
Tighter repression relieves host burden from unintended toxic protein synthesis

ingredients.name: valuable_2
ingredients.criterion: Answer mentions that identifying essential genes via the CRISPR screen helps strain engineers avoid disrupting essential targets, streamlining genome editing workflows.
examples: Essentiality data guides safe editing targets
Avoiding unannotated essential genes prevents workflow disruption

ingredients.name: valuable_3
ingredients.criterion: Answer mentions that engineered ribosomes enable incorporation of multiple non-canonical amino acids into synthesized polypeptides, expanding the chemical space and functionality of producible recombinant proteins.
examples: Ribo-T can incorporate multiple non-canonical amino acids into proteins
Engineered ribosomes enable proteins with novel chemistries

ingredients.name: valuable_4
ingredients.criterion: Answer concludes with a synthesis connecting these advancements—spanning genome editing, expression tuning, and engineered translation machinery—to improved yield, functionality, and expanded therapeutic and industrial applications of recombinant proteins.
examples: These tools collectively enhance yield and functionality of recombinant proteins
Advancements expand applications in therapeutic and industrial protein production
